variables.claim_asserts: Bisected and replicated halves of the paper's active-inference embryo simulation regenerate the complete target after slight dedifferentiation.
variables.test_measures: Target-assignment RMS, correctly typed cells, and identity-probability dips in an independent gradient-descent reimplementation of the model.

modality.note: A simulation replication is appropriate in principle, but this test replaces the published spm_ADEM generalized-filter solver with Euler gradient flow lacking generalized-motion terms.

assumptions.note: Solver dynamics determine whether each half reaches the target basin; result.json explicitly states that spm_ADEM can follow a different path through the free-energy landscape.

scope.claim_scope: The eight-cell active-inference morphogenesis simulation and its bisection procedure.
scope.test_scope: A numpy reimplementation with a different integrator, tested over 20 numpy seeds under two initial spreads and optional process noise.

reasons: The assembly variables are relevant: regeneration requires RMS position error below half the smallest target spacing and at least 7/8 correctly typed cells, while dedifferentiation is a dip in mean_max_p.
The decisive 3/20 and 6/20 both-halves-regenerated counts come from gradient flow, not the published spm_ADEM generalized filtering used for the claimed simulation result.
The omitted embedding-order-2 and local-linearisation dynamics are not a sampling restriction; they define a different numerical dynamical system capable of reaching different morphologies.
All conditions reproduce the dedifferentiation dip in 20/20 runs, so only the solver-dependent regeneration component produces the refutation.
what_would_change_it: Run the published DEM_morphogenesis bisection path with spm_ADEM in MATLAB or a validated numerically equivalent implementation, using the source initial conditions and reporting the same RMS/type outcomes across seeds.
